title: RCT Evaluating First Time Shoulder Dislocation
official: Randomized Trial Evaluating First Time Shoulder Dislocation: Surgery vs Conservative Care
summary: The primary objective of the pilot study is to assess the feasibility of a definitive trial to determine the effect of arthroscopic soft tissue stabilization vs. non-operative management on the risk of recurrent anterior dislocation rates and functional outcomes following in patients presenting with a first-time dislocation (FTD) over a 24-month period.
